find-jelenneth.title: Find Jelenneth or Learn Her Fate
find-jelenneth.summary: Search for Jelenneth, the missing daughter of Parker and Heldrith Laneworth. Rescue her, or learn her fate so her family can have closure.
objectives: Find and rescue Jelenneth, or learn what happened to her.
Return reliable news to her family.

three-items-for-nuanda.title: Three Items for Nuanda Nemere
three-items-for-nuanda.summary: Retrieve the three ritual ingredients Nuanda Nemere requested and bring them to her before she no longer needs them.
objectives: Obtain an amethyst worth at least 50 gp.
Obtain hair from a deceased orc.
Obtain Hwyanthemon.
three-items-for-nuanda.reward: 800 XP each for up to four eligible PCs

k-r-k-caravan-run.title: The K-R-K Caravan Run
k-r-k-caravan-run.summary: Guard Billworth Turgen's caravan from Kirkilston to Raven's Pass and see its cargo safely delivered.
objectives: Protect the caravan and its travelers.
Deliver the surviving wagons to Raven's Pass.
k-r-k-caravan-run.reward: 15 gp each, a meal, and Billworth's offer of future work

plumb-lost-caverns.title: Plumb the Depths of the Lost Caverns
plumb-lost-caverns.summary: Explore the rediscovered Lost Caverns of Achaia on behalf of the mage Delk Whitewand.
objectives: Confirm and enter the Lost Caverns of Achaia.
Explore the caverns and recover their lost secrets.
Give any recovered scrolls and tomes to Delk.
plumb-lost-caverns.reward: 100 gp up front, 10 gp daily, useful potions, and other recovered treasure

reclaim-keep-on-borderlands.title: Reclaim the Keep on the Borderlands
reclaim-keep-on-borderlands.summary: Clear the goblins and bugbears from the abandoned keep that may stand over the ancient dwarf-hold Kharaz-Ankor.
objectives: Clear the keep of its goblin and bugbear occupants.
Investigate the possible entrance to the ancient dwarf-hold.
reclaim-keep-on-borderlands.reward: 25 gp daily for the party for up to 14 days, plus 5 gp per goblin tongue

construct-darkforest-fort.title: Help Reglar Ashbow Construct a Fort in the Darkforest
construct-darkforest-fort.summary: Help Reglar Ashbow construct a fort on the eastern shore of Donally Lake in the Darkforest.
objectives: Meet Reglar Ashbow and agree upon the work.
Travel to the eastern shore of Donally Lake.
Help construct and secure the fort.

find-urvan-and-narinza.title: Find Urvan and Narinza
find-urvan-and-narinza.summary: Determine what happened to Urvan and Narinza after they were separated from the party during the flight from Blightstone Pit.
objectives: Follow signs of the missing companions from Blightstone Pit.
Find Urvan and Narinza, or learn their fates.

free-slaytonthorpe.title: Free Slaytonthorpe from the Terror of Red Tusk
free-slaytonthorpe.summary: Fulfill Cromm's command to Neria by discovering the nature of Red Tusk and ending the terror afflicting Slaytonthorpe.
objectives: Learn who or what Red Tusk is.
Travel to Slaytonthorpe.
Free Slaytonthorpe from Red Tusk's terror.

investigate-cold-mouth.title: Investigate the Cold Mouth and the Deep Friends
investigate-cold-mouth.summary: Investigate the Cold Mouth named in the recovered Toothbreaker orders and identify the Deep Friends collecting captives there.
objectives: Locate the Cold Mouth north of Slaytonthorpe.
Identify Red Tusk and the Deep Friends.
Discover what happened to the captives taken there.

unmask-surface-hand.title: Unmask the Surface Hand Behind the Toothbreakers
unmask-surface-hand.summary: Use Algorn Druff's read of the recovered orders to learn whether a surface faction is directing the Toothbreakers, Red Tusk, and the Deep Friends.
objectives: Compare the two writing styles in the recovered orders.
Look for signs of the Basilisk's Claw, Cult of the Dragon, Zhentarim, or a witch-coven connection.
Identify the faction or agent using the Toothbreakers as muscle.

cleanse-blightstone-pit.title: Make Blightstone Pit Safe Again
cleanse-blightstone-pit.summary: Investigate the creature lairing beneath Blightstone Pit so the old quarry can stop threatening travelers and become useful again.
objectives: Locate the pit and confirm the creature's lair.
Learn whether the creature is connected to the orc attacks or only feeding on the chaos.
Drive off or destroy the creature and verify the quarry is safe.
cleanse-blightstone-pit.reward: Possible quarry rights, salvage, or treasure from prior victims

trace-vanished-elven-holds.title: Trace the Vanished Elven Holds
trace-vanished-elven-holds.summary: Follow Thurgan Newl's rumor that the drow may have been involved in the abandonment of the Glittering Canopy and Aelith-Calaer.
objectives: Gather testimony about the empty elven sites.
Determine whether drow activity around Narinza or Shade points to the vanished holds.
Find out whether the abandonment still threatens surface settlements.

map-kharaz-ankor-entrance.title: Map the Entrance to Kharaz-Ankor
map-kharaz-ankor-entrance.summary: After the Keep on the Borderlands is retaken, survey the passages beneath it and determine whether they truly lead to Kharaz-Ankor.
objectives: Secure the below-ground access after the keep is cleared.
Map the first safe route beneath the keep.
Bring Nolo Silvershaper proof of whether the passage leads to Kharaz-Ankor.

keep-cult-from-valashinaz.title: Keep the Cult from Valashinaz
keep-cult-from-valashinaz.summary: After the Lost Caverns of Achaia are opened, prevent dragon-cult interests from learning whether Valashinaz still waits beneath ruined Achaia.
objectives: Search recovered Achaian maps and tomes for references to Valashinaz.
Watch for Cult of the Dragon agents pursuing the same knowledge.
Secure or destroy the clues before they draw dangerous attention to Achaia.

explore-malviks-tower.title: Explore Malvik's Tower
explore-malviks-tower.summary: Locate the long-lost tower of Malvik the Mad in the forest north of Raven's Pass and investigate the extensive dungeons beneath it. Determine whether Malvik still survives as a lich and recover what can safely be taken from his trove.
explore-malviks-tower.giver: Rumors among travelers at Raven's Pass
objectives: Search east of the trail north of Raven's Pass for Malvik's lost tower.
Enter and explore the dungeons beneath the tower.
Determine whether Malvik became a lich and still inhabits the complex.
Return with proof of the tower's location and any safely recovered lore or treasure.
explore-malviks-tower.reward: Any gold and magic recovered from Malvik's unclaimed trove

trace-murfex-last-journey.title: Trace Murfex's Last Journey
trace-murfex-last-journey.summary: Retrace master glassworker Murfex Garrick's final journey toward Threshold. Discover where and how he died, recover his missing work, and determine whether his death was an accident or connected to his experimental glassware.
trace-murfex-last-journey.giver: Jelb Garrick and the Garrick family
objectives: Establish Murfex's intended route and reason for traveling to Threshold.
Find witnesses or physical traces from his final journey.
Determine the circumstances of Murfex's death.
Recover his experimental glassware, notes, or unfinished masterpiece for the Garrick family.
trace-murfex-last-journey.reward: To be arranged with the Garrick family

investigate-impurax-resurgence.title: Investigate the Rot in the Forbidden Zone
investigate-impurax-resurgence.summary: Enter the Forbidden Zone and investigate reports that the worship of Impurax, the Rotten God, has reappeared there. Identify the resurgent cult's leaders, learn what they are cultivating or corrupting, and prevent the blight from spreading beyond the ruined region.
objectives: Find evidence of Impurax's renewed worship in the Forbidden Zone.
Identify any Putrescalate cleric-druids or warriors of the Fanged Legion.
Discover the cult's source of pestilence, rot, or corrupted fungal life.
Destroy or contain the immediate threat and report what remains.

recover-calico-five-remains.title: Recover the Calico Five
recover-calico-five-remains.summary: Slengar Skullcrusher, sole survivor of the Calico Five, seeks closure for the companions lost during their incursion into Gundgathol. Retrace their expedition, find the site where a deep dragon destroyed the company, and recover the fallen clerics' remains and sacred possessions.
objectives: Find Slengar in Khalidheroneth and record his account of the expedition.
Retrace the Calico Five's route into Gundgathol.
Locate the place where the company encountered the deep dragon.
Recover Cheluthim's remains and the sacred possessions of the fallen clerics.
Determine whether the deep dragon still threatens the route.
recover-calico-five-remains.reward: To be arranged with Slengar Skullcrusher

harvest-xanderpetals.title: Harvest Xanderpetals
harvest-xanderpetals.summary: Gosterwick's supply of Xanderpetals is running dangerously low. Travel to the cold, barren lands where the plant grows, gather enough of its vivid red flowers to replenish the town's stores, and return before the remaining sedative tonic is exhausted.
objectives: Learn how to identify and safely harvest Xanderpetals.
Travel to the cold, barren lands where the plant grows.
Gather enough intact flowers to replenish Gosterwick's medicinal stores.
Return the Xanderpetals to Gosterwick before its remaining tonic is exhausted.
harvest-xanderpetals.reward: To be arranged with Gosterwick's healers

find-darkforest-giants-grave.title: Find the Giant's Grave
find-darkforest-giants-grave.summary: Search the heart of the Darkforest for the legendary grave of a giant slain by a red-scaled, horned dragon. Verify the old tale, discover what became of the dragon, and recover any relics buried with the giant.
find-darkforest-giants-grave.giver: Rumors among travelers at Raven's Pass
objectives: Gather accounts describing the giant, the horned dragon, and possible landmarks.
Travel into the heart of the Darkforest.
Locate and enter the giant's grave.
Determine whether the dragon survived or left descendants behind.
Recover proof of the grave's discovery and any safely transportable relics.
find-darkforest-giants-grave.reward: Any unclaimed treasure recovered from the grave

find-the-cold-mouth.title: Find the Cold Mouth
find-the-cold-mouth.summary: Follow the route recorded in the recovered Tooth-Breaker orders to locate the Cold Mouth, where Red-Tusk's orcs deliver kidnapped scholars, priests, craftspeople, and laborers to mysterious Deep Friends. Rescue any surviving captives and uncover who or what is collecting them.
objectives: Decode the crude route beginning near Slaytonthorpe.
Follow the dead stream and broken stones beyond the thorn hills.
Locate the watcher-mark and the entrance called the Cold Mouth.
Rescue captives awaiting collection by the Deep Friends.
Identify the Deep Friends and learn why they seek maps, sealed doors, old tunnels, and knowledge of the deep places.
find-the-cold-mouth.reward: Any supplies or treasure seized from the kidnappers, plus gratitude from rescued captives

find-doors-of-galduhr.title: Find the Doors of Galduhr
find-doors-of-galduhr.summary: Continue Bran Hammerspike's decades-long search for the fabled Doors of Galduhr, the lost entrance to the dwarven kingdom of Gundgathol. Retrace the expedition he undertook with Crynwyth Ironfist in the Moon Peaks, survive the elemental dangers they encountered, and find evidence that reveals the Doors' location.
objectives: Research Bran Hammerspike's expeditions in search of the Doors of Galduhr.
Retrace Bran and Crynwyth Ironfist's route through the Moon Peaks.
Find evidence of their encounter with a fire elemental.
Recover maps, markers, or records left during Bran's search.
Locate the Doors of Galduhr or establish the strongest surviving lead to them.
find-doors-of-galduhr.reward: Dwarven treasure or historical artifacts recovered during the expedition

establish-darkforest-fort.title: Establish the Darkforest Fort
establish-darkforest-fort.summary: Reglar 'The Ashbow' Lightstep is hiring able-bodied adventurers to help construct a fort in the Darkforest. Escort workers and supplies to the eastern shore of Donally Lake, secure the building site, and defend the expedition until the fort is usable.
objectives: Meet Reglar Lightstep and agree upon wages and responsibilities.
Assemble the workers, tools, and supplies needed for construction.
Travel approximately twelve miles southwest of Kirkilston to Donally Lake.
Survey and secure a defensible site on the lake's eastern shore.
Protect the workers until they complete a usable fortification.
establish-darkforest-fort.reward: Wages to be negotiated with Reglar Lightstep

gather-secrets-for-nimba.title: Gather Secrets for Nimba
gather-secrets-for-nimba.summary: Help Nimba Armstrong gather intelligence from the miners, guards, and travelers frequenting the Mason's Apron without exposing her life as a deep-cover spy. Identify information that could threaten the Nemere family's interests and report it to Nimba discreetly.
objectives: Meet Nimba discreetly at the Mason's Apron.
Observe conversations among the tavern's miners, guards, and travelers.
Identify secrets or developing events relevant to Nimba's interests.
Investigate the most credible lead without exposing Nimba's involvement.
Deliver the intelligence privately to Nimba while preserving her cover.
gather-secrets-for-nimba.reward: Nimba Armstrong's favor and access to selected intelligence from her network

find-missing-fevered.title: Find the Missing Fevered
find-missing-fevered.summary: Three of five Raven's Pass townsfolk afflicted by Dream Fever vanished during the previous week instead of being found in the surrounding fields and hills. Investigate Harl's suspicion that the disappearances are connected to Xanderpetals, recover any survivors, and discover what is taking the Fevered.
objectives: Question Harl and the families of the three missing townsfolk.
Search the fields and hills between the town and Raven's Pass.
Determine how Xanderpetals or Dream Fever relate to the disappearances.
Recover any survivors and stop whatever is taking the Fevered.
find-missing-fevered.reward: 75 gp pooled by the affected families, plus salvage rights

contain-soul-fungus-mordoom.title: Contain the Soul Fungus at Mordoom Keep
contain-soul-fungus-mordoom.summary: The Sporebane Brotherhood needs an expedition to the epicenter of Mordoom Keep's Soul Fungus outbreak. Assess whether the infection is spreading, trace Elowen Starshadow's missing mentor, and recover research or samples that may help contain the plague.
objectives: Survey Mordoom Keep for new fungal growth and infected wildlife.
Trace Elowen's mentor's final expedition into the keep.
Recover the mentor's research, remains, or both.
Secure a contained sample without looking directly at active fungal growths.
Return to the Sporebane Brotherhood before any infection can incubate.
contain-soul-fungus-mordoom.reward: Sporebane protective magic, treatment during incubation, and salvage rights

demon-beyond-east-tower.title: The Demon Beyond the East Tower
demon-beyond-east-tower.summary: Sixteen years ago, Kelda Rue's failed summoning dragged her master, Thelgarr Blackstaff, into another plane. Search his abandoned laboratory, determine whether he still lives, and prevent the summoned demon from finding a path back into Issenda.
objectives: Search Thelgarr Blackstaff's abandoned laboratory.
Reconstruct the summoning ritual that opened the planar passage.
Locate or safely reopen the passage to the plane that claimed Thelgarr.
Rescue Thelgarr, recover proof of his death, or permanently seal the breach.
demon-beyond-east-tower.reward: Kelda Rue's magical guidance and access to temple resources

rot-grey-company.title: Rot in the Grey Company
rot-grey-company.summary: Radloc Hudson suspects Darkeyes agents are bribing Grey Company guards and compromising Eastdale's caravans and warehouses. Investigate from outside the company, expose the corruption, and identify the Darkeyes mastermind without alerting potentially compromised personnel.
objectives: Identify compromised Grey Company guards.
Protect a vulnerable shipment or operate a decoy caravan.
Trace stolen goods through Eastdale's underground routes.
Identify the Darkeyes mastermind without exposing the investigation prematurely.
rot-grey-company.reward: To be negotiated with Radloc Hudson

captives-shrieken-mire.title: Captives of Shrieken Mire
captives-shrieken-mire.summary: Blue goblins have carried several townsfolk into Shrieken Mire, territory protected by lizardfolk who worship the ancient green dragon Inzeldrin.
objectives: Track the captives into the mire.
Learn why the goblins took them.
Rescue any survivors.
Avoid provoking Inzeldrin or turning the lizardfolk against Slaytonthorpe.
captives-shrieken-mire.reward: To be arranged with the rescued families; possible goblin salvage

silence-ford-isenduin.title: Silence at Ford-at-Isenduin
silence-ford-isenduin.summary: Billworth's promised follow-up work concerns caravans disappearing near Ford-at-Isenduin. Wagons have been found abandoned, but neither cargo nor travelers remain.
objectives: Investigate the abandoned wagons.
Identify who is controlling the ford.
Recover survivors and stolen cargo.
Make the crossing safe for future caravans.
silence-ford-isenduin.reward: Negotiable payment from Billworth, plus authorized salvage

failing-mythalvane.title: The Failing Mythalvane
failing-mythalvane.summary: The Mythalvane's magical protection has begun failing unpredictably. Rafell Riverwarden's surviving research points to a buried relay chamber outside Helix.
objectives: Locate the relay chamber.
Determine whether the failures result from decay or sabotage.
Recover or repair the damaged component.
Keep the failing defenses secret from Helix's enemies.
failing-mythalvane.reward: Seeker favor and restricted access to their historical records

sabotage-guardians-rest.title: Sabotage at Guardians' Rest
sabotage-guardians-rest.summary: Supplies have been poisoned and gate mechanisms damaged at Guardians' Rest shortly before caravan season. Evidence implicates Mordicar Justhand's household, but appears suspiciously convenient.
objectives: Secure the caravan station against further attacks.
Identify how the saboteur gained access.
Determine who benefits from discrediting Father Zistrus.
Prevent the dispute from disrupting trade between Kirkilston and Eastdale.
sabotage-guardians-rest.reward: Payment, free resupply, and future lodging at Guardians' Rest

thirsting-pool.title: The Thirsting Pool
thirsting-pool.summary: Phultarr's Pool, an inexplicable freshwater lake beyond living memory, is shrinking rapidly. Its retreating shoreline has exposed ancient stone steps descending beneath the water.
thirsting-pool.giver: Caravan masters crossing the Rauth Desert
objectives: Determine what is draining the lake.
Explore the newly exposed structure.
Restore the desert's freshwater supply.
Discover whether the pool is Demetra's Tears, Oaxus' Blood, or something older.
thirsting-pool.reward: Recovered relics and the gratitude of desert travelers

shrine-fire-burns-hot.title: When the Shrine Fire Burns Hot
shrine-fire-burns-hot.summary: The eternal flame at Sir Ardan Hearthward's shrine has begun burning unnaturally hot, an omen of danger emerging from deeper in the Blanryde Hills. Follow the warning, rescue those endangered by it, and confront the wilderness threat.
objectives: Gather reports of missing travelers and unusual activity.
Follow forgotten cairns and old sheep paths into the Blanryde Hills.
Find and rescue the missing.
Eliminate the wilderness threat or clearly mark its lair.
shrine-fire-burns-hot.reward: Sir Ardan's aid, friendship, and knowledge of forgotten paths
